spans.s: मक् vt. 1Ā (pres. मंकते) 1. To adorn; 2. to go, to move.
मक्क् vt. 1Ā (pres. मक्कते) To go, to move.

मकर m. 1. A kind of sea-animal resembling the crocodile; (it is regarded as an emblem of the god of love), छंदोज्ञाननिधिं जघान मकरो वेलातटे पिङ्गलम् Panch.ii., Bhartr.ii.4; 2. the sign Capricornus of the zodiac; 3. an array of troops in the form of a Makara; 4. one of the nine treasures of Kubera; 5. an ear-ring in the shape of a Makara.
माकर a. (f. री) Belonging to the sea-monster Makara.
